lines.x: Chile's consumer price index rose 0.5% in October, matching forecasts but confirming year-end inflation could close near 5%, cementing market expectations of a December interest rate hike by the central bank.
Chilean state-owned miner Codelco admitted to overstating copper production by over 42,000 tonnes during 2024 and 2025.
The Chilean stock market fell 1.52% as a Wall Street slump weakened the peso to 978.36 per dollar.
LATAM Airlines earned $441 million in the third quarter, a 16% increase, but cut its 2026 profit forecast due to surging fuel costs.
